points.point: The Vault's automotive radar content is confined to the AREG800A radar echo generator, which is not a VNA
points.label: partial
points.why: Identifies AREG800A as an automotive radar echo generator, but does not state it is not a VNA and adds VNA-measurement claims.

points.point: The automotive radar frequency bands documented in the Vault are 24–24.25 GHz, 76–81 GHz and 24–44 GHz (FE44S), given for radar echo generator frontends
points.label: missing
points.why: Does not state the documented frontend bands 24–24.25 GHz, 76–81 GHz, or FE44S 24–44 GHz.

points.point: The Vault distinguishes FMCW from non-FMCW radar only in the echo-generation/distance context, not as a VNA measurement requirement
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions FMCW in echo-generation/distance context, but omits the non-FMCW distinction and the point that this is not a VNA requirement.

points.point: The ZNA VNA family page describes coverage from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz with no reference to radar or automotive use cases
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions ZNA up to 67 GHz, but omits 10 MHz start and the absence of radar/automotive context.

points.point: mmWave VNA coverage in the Vault extends to 110 GHz via the ZNA67EXT converter-head system, stated purely as instrument specification
points.label: partial
points.why: States ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz, but not that this is via converter heads or only an instrument specification.

points.point: ZNA67EXT dynamic-range data is segmented by band, including the 75 GHz to 80 GHz segment that overlaps the 76–81 GHz radar band, but the Vault never attributes this to radar needs
points.label: missing
points.why: No segmented ZNA67EXT dynamic-range data or 75–80 GHz overlap is mentioned.

points.point: ZNB3000 VNA models are documented with frequency upgrade options up to 54.0 GHz, again with no radar or automotive application context
points.label: missing
points.why: No ZNB3000 upgrade coverage up to 54.0 GHz or lack of radar context is mentioned.

invented: “the VNA must handle specified IF-transfer and ghost-object-suppression measurements”
“For AREG800A IF transfer characteristics, the VNA measurement condition is…”
“For suppression of ghost objects, the measurement condition is a vector network analyzer in time domain”
